# Celebrating Lives. Beginning Healing.

[Learn More][41]
[Batesville most trusted company home page banner]

### Serving the Next Generation of Families Together

As the needs of families and your funeral home businesses evolve, we are delivering new cremation,
burial and technology solutions. See how you can deliver thoughtful, compassionate ways to help
families through their journey and celebrate the lives of those they love.

[shelves of cremation products]

### Expanded Cremation Choices

Our cremation offering continues to grow with more than 60 new urns across styles and sizes,
allowing families to find the perfect option for every tribute.

[Learn More][42]
[what's new wood and metal caskets]

### New Choices in Burial: Wood & Metal Caskets

Families have more options than ever with new introductions across our wood and metal caskets.

[Learn More][43]
[Computer screen showing family choices digital showroom]

### Family Choices^{®} Digital Showroom

The Family Choices^{®} Digital Showroom is an easy-to-use, online solution that gives you a guided
path to walk families through their burial casket, cremation and personalization options,
simplifying the product selection process.

[Learn More][44]
[girl touching medallion on casket]

### Family Choices® Personalization Options

Family Choices® is more than a collection of products; it’s a complete personalization solution
designed to reflect every family’s story.

[Learn More][45]
[remembrance jewelry header cross necklace]

### Remembrance Jewelry

Batesville's remembrance jewelry collections provide meaningful, beautiful options to keep memories
close.

[Learn More][46]
[veteran american flag patch]

### Honoring Veterans

We believe in honoring our nation’s veterans. Batesville provides resources to help remember
veterans with respect and dignity—with guides, articles, and products made specifically for military
service members and their families.

[Honoring Veterans][47]
[dimension casket in showroom]

### Dimensions Caskets

Our Dimensions^{®} by Batesville oversize caskets are designed with wider widths to suit families
searching for alternatives to standard caskets.

[Dimensions Caskets][48]

## For Families

Find grief support and guidance on planning a funeral. View caskets, urns and keepsakes to
understand your options.
* [Why a Funeral?][49]
* [Planning a Funeral][50]
* [About Family Choices®][51]

## For Funeral Professionals

Explore product information, business tools and educational resources to help you better serve
families.
* [Why Batesville?][52]
* [Funeral Industry Technology Solutions][53]
* [Place an Order][54]

## Resources

Read helpful information on planning a funeral, honoring loved ones, and planning a meaningful
funeral service.

# The Everstory experience

At Everstory, we focus on what matters most by investing in our people, operations and locations so
we can serve families and communities with care during life’s most meaningful moments.

###### Family Experience

#### [Serving families with care and consistency][17]

In less than a year, Everstory transformed outdated paper maps and contracts into world-class
digital tools across nearly 400 cemetery locations. With digitized contracts and services, most
accompanied by aerial drone mapping, these advancements help protect families’ choices and support a
more seamless experience during the planning process.

[Read more][18]

###### Employee Experience

#### [Creating opportunities for growth,
#### learning, and leadership][19]

At Everstory, we believe that developing our people is key to delivering on our mission of creating
supportive spaces where individuals and families can find solace, meaning, and hope in the midst of
loss. One way we do this is by investing in growth opportunities that connect team members to new
ideas, evolving trends, and the broader funeral and cemetery profession.

[Read more][20]

###### Location Investment

#### [Investing in spaces that reflect
#### dignity and care][21]

Over the past three years, we have invested more than $75 million across our 460 locations to
enhance the spaces where we serve families. Read more about our most recent renovation project at
Vista Funeral Home in Miami Lakes, Florida.

[Read more][22]

## Everstory is a unique blend of long-standing traditions of caring for the deceased with a fresh

Who we are

###### WHO WE ARE

## Everstory’s foundation is strengthened by community commitment.

##### Trust

We focus on what matters most: investing in our people, strengthening our operations and facilities,
improving service consistency, and maintaining confidence with the families we serve.

# ACT Tombstone Services Cc

## A Legacy To Be Remembered

**ABOUT**
ACT Tombstone Services Cc is a family owned and operated business located in the Mpumalanga Province
of South Africa. We specialize in the sale, design, and installation of beautiful gravestones.

We are dedicated to providing our clients with the best possible service. With over 20 years of
experience, we understand the value of a meaningful grave memorial honoring the ones who have
passed. We strive to bring families closer together by creating a place of reflection and
remembrance.

We specialize in providing a wide range of tombstones or memorial plaques in a variety of colors and
shapes to match the unique needs of our customers. We offer a variety of services, including
memorial tombstone designs, installation, maintenance, cleaning of the grave, grave markers and even
palisades to protect the grave from unwanted intruders.

Our staff is highly skilled in the design and installation. We are eager to provide a personalized
and stress-free experience for our clients. Our commitment to superior customer service and quality
products ensure that our clients receive the best possible everlasting memorial. We are bound to
provide the highest quality of service and craftsmanship with reasonable pricing considering all.
Our goal is to provide compassionate and personalized service to each and every customer. Offering
an unconditional lifetime guarantee on all tombstones, ACT Tombstone Services Cc is the perfect
choice for memorializing your loved ones.
INFORMATION
*Here at ACT we offer each customer the option of a cash sale or a 12 month lay-buy sale with no
intrest. *

*After the client's stone is paid in full, an erection date will be settled along with all the
paperwork that follows. No refunds are allowed. *

*W**e erect tombstones country wide with additional traveling fees. We have branches in Kriel,
Ermelo, Standerton & Warden. We offer an online service for those that can't attend at the shop. *

*And just like that we have a lot more to offer.*
* Feel free to contact us anytime.*

# ACT Tombstone Services Cc

## A Legacy To Be Remembered

**ABOUT**
ACT Tombstone Services Cc is a family owned and operated business located in the Mpumalanga Province
of South Africa. We specialize in the sale, design, and installation of beautiful gravestones.

We are dedicated to providing our clients with the best possible service. With over 20 years of
experience, we understand the value of a meaningful grave memorial honoring the ones who have
passed. We strive to bring families closer together by creating a place of reflection and
remembrance.

We specialize in providing a wide range of tombstones or memorial plaques in a variety of colors and
shapes to match the unique needs of our customers. We offer a variety of services, including
memorial tombstone designs, installation, maintenance, cleaning of the grave, grave markers and even
palisades to protect the grave from unwanted intruders.

Our staff is highly skilled in the design and installation. We are eager to provide a personalized
and stress-free experience for our clients. Our commitment to superior customer service and quality
products ensure that our clients receive the best possible everlasting memorial. We are bound to
provide the highest quality of service and craftsmanship with reasonable pricing considering all.
Our goal is to provide compassionate and personalized service to each and every customer. Offering
an unconditional lifetime guarantee on all tombstones, ACT Tombstone Services Cc is the perfect
choice for memorializing your loved ones.
INFORMATION
*Here at ACT we offer each customer the option of a cash sale or a 12 month lay-buy sale with no
intrest. *

*After the client's stone is paid in full, an erection date will be settled along with all the
paperwork that follows. No refunds are allowed. *

*W**e erect tombstones country wide with additional traveling fees. We have branches in Kriel,

Play Video
Play Video

### ASCO 2026: "The results that we presented from the RASolute 302 trial are unprecedented." - The
### CEO behind this year's pancreatic cancer breakthrough walks us through the full results and
### implications | 05/31/26

Dr. Mark Goldsmith of Revolution Medicines describes the benefit seen by advanced patients who
received the pancreatic cancer pill daraxonrasib vs those in a control group of investigator's
choice standard-of-care chemotherapy, and he discusses the medicine's side effect profile. Plus,
next steps for this treatment in pancreatic cancer and beyond.
[ASCO 2026: Bicara Therapeutics is presenting long-term follow up data at ASCO that it believes
shows durability derived from choosing TGF-β with EGFR for its fusion protein in HPV negative head &
neck | 05/31/26]
Play Video
Play Video
05:44

### ASCO 2026: Bicara Therapeutics is presenting long-term follow up data at ASCO that it believes
### shows durability derived from choosing TGF-β with EGFR for its fusion protein in HPV negative
### head & neck | 05/31/26

CEO Claire Mazumdar describes the ASCO data, and updates us on the phase 2/3 study, which is already
in the phase 3 portion. Bicara hopes to use the study to eventually gain an accelerated approval.
[ASCO 2026: Fresh off an IPO, Eikon Therapeutics Chairman & CEO Roger Perlmutter describes the
scientific idea behind the company, and walks us through the leading programs | 05/31/26]
Play Video
Play Video
35:05

### ASCO 2026: Fresh off an IPO, Eikon Therapeutics Chairman & CEO Roger Perlmutter describes the
### scientific idea behind the company, and walks us through the leading programs | 05/31/26

The lead two programs, which target TLR7/8 and PARP1, have data at ASCO and were licensed with the
idea of laying the foundation for clinical expertise at Eikon. Another clinical program, a WRN
helicase inhibitor, is the first to entirely come out of Eikon's platform. Plus, Dr. Perlmutter's
take on being a public company, and his thoughts on China as a medicine cabinet to the world.
[ASCO 2026: Summit Therapeutics' Co-CEO and Chief Strategy Officer discuss the HARMONi-6 ASCO data
release for the PD-1xVEGF bi-specific antibody Ivonescimab | 06/01/26]
Play Video
Play Video
14:55

### ASCO 2026: Summit Therapeutics' Co-CEO and Chief Strategy Officer discuss the HARMONi-6 ASCO
### data release for the PD-1xVEGF bi-specific antibody Ivonescimab | 06/01/26

Maky Zanganeh and Dave Gancarz share their take on the result, which at the topline showed that
Ivonescimab plus chemo reduced the risk of death by 34% vs the PD-1 Tislelizumab plus chemo, and
they are given the opportunity to respond to some of the pushback heard around McCormick Place.
[ASCO 2026: Celcuity CEO Brian Sullivan discusses the late breaking data for the PAM inhibitor
gedatolisib that was just presented at ASCO - doubled the likelihood of survival in HR+/HER2- breast
| 06/02/26]
Play Video
Play Video
09:22

### ASCO 2026: Celcuity CEO Brian Sullivan discusses the late breaking data for the PAM inhibitor
### gedatolisib that was just presented at ASCO - doubled the likelihood of survival in HR+/HER2-
### breast | 06/02/26

These data were for patients with the PIK3CA mutation. The median PFS for the gedatolisib triplet
combo was 11.1 months versus 5.6 months, compared to alpelisib plus fulvestrant.
[ASCO 2026: Immuneering presented an update of the P2 trial of its deep cyclic inhibitor of MEK in
1L pancreatic cancer at ASCO. CEO Ben Zeskind argues why competitor data should not overshadow this
| 06/1/26]
Play Video
Play Video
15:58

### ASCO 2026: Immuneering presented an update of the P2 trial of its deep cyclic inhibitor of MEK
### in 1L pancreatic cancer at ASCO. CEO Ben Zeskind argues why competitor data should not
### overshadow this | 06/1/26

He describes the data, which showed a 17.3 months median OS in 55 patients vs. 8.5 months for SoC,
and descrbies why he believes the therapy has an ideal profile for first line patients. A phase
three study is already active and accruing patients.

ABV Technology has acquired the brewery, a longtime partner of the business, and will reopen it

### [Brewbound Voices: The A-B Consent Decree Expired Earlier This Week. What Now?][124]

Jul. 22, 2026 at 12:06 PM by Special to Brewbound

Ten years ago, the Justice Department (DOJ) allowed the world’s largest brewer (Anheuser-Busch
InBev) to buy the world’s second largest brewer (SABMiller), but only after imposing rules designed
to protect competition and keep the market open. Those rules expire this month. This is what they
did, and why their expiration matters.

[ ][125]

### [Goose Island Unveils Sweet 2026 Bourbon County Brand Stout Collection][126]

Jul. 22, 2026 at 10:42 AM by Jessica Infante

In the midst of a summer of hard sports drinks and the revitalization of light beer, Goose Island is
hoping to steer the conversation toward dark, moody imperial stouts for at least a little bit. The
Anheuser-Busch InBev-owned craft brewery has revealed its dessert-laden 2026 Bourbon County Brand
Stout (BCBS) lineup. The barrel-aged stout family is traditionally released on Black Friday
(November 27 this year).

# Headstones, Monuments, Memorials & Restoration Services

Serving Santa Maria & Central Coast families with care and integrity.

[ Our Services ][7]
[ Request a Consultation ][8]

## Trusted Experience

Years of hands-on experience serving families with care and attention to detail.

## Top Craftsmanship

Memorials created using durable materials and precise workmanship.

## Full-Service Support

Guidance and coordination throughout the entire process, from start to finish.

## Lasting Quality

A commitment to workmanship designed to endure for years to come.

## A Name You Can Trust

[asset 2][asset 2]

At Coast Valley Monuments & Memorials, we recognize the importance of the trust you place in us when
honoring a loved one’s legacy. We approach every memorial with care, craftsmanship, and a steadfast
commitment to quality.

We assist families with the design, fabrication, installation, and long-term care of headstones,
monuments, grave markers, niches, and memorial pieces, ensuring each is handled with respect and
attention to detail.

[ Learn More ][9]
[headstone services][headstone services]

## Our Services

Comprehensive memorial services designed to honor and preserve cherished memories.

[tombstone with cross][tombstone with cross]

### Columbarium & Niche Memorials

Custom columbarium and niche memorials designed to provide a dignified and lasting place of
remembrance.

[RIP on tombstone][RIP on tombstone]

### Final Date Inscriptions

Professional final date inscriptions carefully matched to existing lettering for a seamless and
respectful finish.

[tombstone with brush][tombstone with brush]

### Headstones & Gravemarkers

Custom headstones and grave markers crafted from high-quality granite and designed to honor your
loved one’s legacy.

[tombstone][tombstone]

### Installation & Cemetery Services

Expert installation services ensuring proper placement, stability, and compliance with cemetery
requirements.

[Tombstone with check icon][Tombstone with check icon]

### Memorial Maintenance & Care

Our ongoing care programs are designed to preserve the appearance and condition of memorials year
after year.

[Tomb icon with pen][Tomb icon with pen]

### Cleaning & Restoration

Professional cleaning and restoration services to revive and protect memorials affected by time and
the elements.

## We Care

[asset 2][asset 2]

We care for the memorials, markers and monuments that honor your loved ones.

Time brings healing, but also the slow deterioration of these symbols of love.

With our care and restoration plans, we help preserve your loved one’s memory.

[headstone cleaning][headstone cleaning]
[Coast Valley Monuments][Coast Valley Monuments]
[Portfolio][Portfolio]

## Frequently Asked Questions

[asset 2][asset 2]
What services do you offer?
We provide a full range of memorial services, including headstones and grave markers, columbarium
and niche memorials, final date inscriptions, cleaning and restoration, memorial maintenance, and
cemetery installation services.
Can you help guide us through the process?
Yes. We guide families through each step with care and clarity, from design and engraving to
installation and ongoing care.
Do you work directly with cemeteries?
Yes. We coordinate with cemeteries to ensure all requirements, approvals, and installation
guidelines are properly handled.
How long does the process typically take?
Timelines vary depending on the service and level of customization. We provide clear expectations
once we review your specific needs.
Do you offer ongoing care or updates for existing memorials?
Yes. We offer services such as final date inscriptions, cleaning and restoration, and memorial
maintenance to support families over time.

## Get In Touch

## Contact Information

### Location

1003 E Stowell Rd,
Santa Maria, CA 93454

### Phone

805-922-8463

## Schedule a Consultation

[praying hands][praying hands]

## We’re Here to Help You Every Step of the Way

📞 Prefer to Speak With Us Directly?

Call us anytime during business hours — we are here to help.

Honoring memories through timeless craftsmanship. Proudly serving the Central Coast of California.

## Your team has already done all the hard work:

### You can trust our expertise to create a unique, memorable deal toy or custom award.

[40 Anniversary cpresence]

For over 40 years, The Corporate Presence has helped clients celebrate success and further their
brands through fully customized deal toys, as well as recognition gifts and awards.

[About Us][31]
[Financial Tombstone, Black Rock, The Corporate Presence]

## Decades of Experience

Benefit from our 40+ years of design experience to inspire your custom design. We respond quickly to
your requests and keep you updated on the status. Our history of reliability ensures you won’t feel
abandoned in the process.

[Corporate Awards 101][32]

## Partner for Creative Designs

The Corporate Presence partners with you in creating a customized deal toy to celebrate your team’s
success and build client relationships while recognizing the contribution of each team member.

[FAQs][33]
[M&A Tombstones, Sky to Comcast, The Corporate Presence]
[Deal Toys, The Corporate Presence]

## Building Your Brand

Build the company brand, solidify client relationships, and create a visible resume of your
accomplishments with deal toys to commemorate the meaningful moments. These awards travel with
individual team members for their entire career: make sure yours stands out from the rest while
representing your effort with a custom design.

[Industries][34]

## Not Sure What You Want?

You don’t need to have a specific design in mind to get started. We’ll guide you through the entire
creative process. Reach out to us now.

[Get Started][35]

You’re not a designer, but now you need to order an award or deal toy?

### You can trust our expertise to create a unique, memorable deal toy or custom award.

[40 Anniversary cpresence]

For over 40 years, The Corporate Presence has helped clients celebrate success and further their
brands through fully customized deal toys, as well as recognition gifts and awards.

[About Us][31]
[Financial Tombstone, Black Rock, The Corporate Presence]

## Decades of Experience

Benefit from our 40+ years of design experience to inspire your custom design. We respond quickly to
your requests and keep you updated on the status. Our history of reliability ensures you won’t feel
abandoned in the process.

[Corporate Awards 101][32]

## Partner for Creative Designs

The Corporate Presence partners with you in creating a customized deal toy to celebrate your team’s
success and build client relationships while recognizing the contribution of each team member.

[FAQs][33]
[M&A Tombstones, Sky to Comcast, The Corporate Presence]
[Deal Toys, The Corporate Presence]

## Building Your Brand

Build the company brand, solidify client relationships, and create a visible resume of your
accomplishments with deal toys to commemorate the meaningful moments. These awards travel with
individual team members for their entire career: make sure yours stands out from the rest while
representing your effort with a custom design.

[Industries][34]

## Not Sure What You Want?

You don’t need to have a specific design in mind to get started. We’ll guide you through the entire
creative process. Reach out to us now.

[Get Started][35]
[Custom Lucite Embedment with Drug Vial]

Answer a few questions (we’ll remember to ask everything you might have forgotten) to kick-off the

### Design Based on Your Input

We do the creative work for you, listening carefully to your answers so our designs hit the mark.

# Discover Tombstone, Arizona.
# History Lives Here Every Day!

**Welcome to the Official Visitor Website for the City of Tombstone, Arizona**
Discover the many experiences that await you in “The Town Too Tough to Die.”
Walk the same historic streets once traveled by Wyatt Earp, Doc Holliday, and the Clantons more than
140 years ago—and feel the spirit of the Old West come alive.

From historic attractions and lively saloons to unique shops and delicious dining, there’s something
for everyone in Tombstone.
Need more than a day to take it all in? Stay the night at one of over 20 local lodging options and
keep the adventure going.

Tombstone, Arizona’s unique history is reflected in the many Attractions you will find here.
Available are a variety of Museums, the original Silver Mine under Tombstone’s streets, Stagecoach
and Trolley Tours, Gunfight Reenactments, and other attractions that bring the history of The Town
Too Tough to Die to life.

quench your thirst you can find what you are wanting here in Tombstone.

our many Shops and Galleries. You can find Antiques, Books, Western Clothing, Souvenirs and a whole
mess of other things to bring home from your trip to the Town Too Tough to Die.

# Monuments in West Columbia, SC

[Tombstones]Fletcher Monuments is your all-in-one provider of gravemarker services, from custom
[**laser etching**][15] and creation to installation and engraving, to [**monument repairs**][16],
cleaning and more.

We make sure your tombstone, civic memorial or granite signage always looks its best, so it can
continue to serve as a clear commemoration.

[Contact Us Today!][17]

## Creation, Maintenance and Repairs

Tombstones in West Columbia, SC are powerful testaments to a person’s legacy. They tell us more than
just when they lived and died, but also who they were and what was important to them. And, when a
tombstone is all that’s left to remember them by, it’s important to make sure their gravemarker is
getting the attention it needs to look beautiful—even against weathering and time. Fletcher
Monuments is here to provide complete service for tombstones, including repairs, maintenance and
cleaning. In addition, we also design and create new ones, bringing unique ideas to life in the
perfect way to immortalize someone you care deeply about.

[Tombstones]
[Tombstones]

Our abilities aren’t limited to cleaning and repairs in West Columbia, Lexington County, or Cayce,
SC, either! We also offer a rich scope of etching and engraving services. Whether we’re bringing a
photorealistic portrait to life on the face of a tombstone or simply restoring the lettering on an
aged memorial, our team engraves with precision and care. This service is available at our shop or
on-site—wherever it’s required. It’s not just restricted to tombstones, either! We can custom
engrave just about anything that holds value for you, including urns. If the time has come for you
to immortalize a loved one’s memory or breathe new life into an old grave, we’re the ones to call.

[Learn More][18] [View Our Portfolio][19]
* We’re your all-inclusive services provider, including creation, installation, repairs, cleaning
  and more.
* Our business is locally-owned and -operated, proudly serving customers throughout West Columbia
  and all of South Carolina.
* In addition to tombstones, we also provide services for granite signage and civic memorials.
* For etching, all work is done on-site. We have the power to inscribe any monument.
* We’re members of the Elberta Granite Association (EGA) and an Authorized JAHN Installer.

### Starting at $1850

### $725 with Porcelain image

### Starting at $2050

### Starting at $475

## Complete Care

[Tombstones]Ensure your tribute is beautifully crafted, neatly inscribed and well-maintained with
the help of Fletcher Monuments.

Contact us today for more information or for pricing and estimates.

Along with offering monument sales and maintenance to the following areas, we are happy to travel to
jobs outside of our normal service area as well.

[Contact Us Today!][20]

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Do you provide custom engraving and artwork on monuments?

Yes. Fletcher Monuments offers full custom engraving and artwork on all types of monuments. From
detailed laser etching and photorealistic portraits to precise lettering and personalized designs,
we can create or restore any inscription. Engraving can be done in our shop or on-site in West
Columbia, SC.

### What types of monuments do you offer in West Columbia, SC?

We provide a wide range of monuments and memorials, including tombstones, civic memorials, granite
signage, and urns. Each piece is custom-made to reflect your loved one’s legacy, with services
available for both residential and commercial clients throughout West Columbia and all of South
Carolina.

### How long does monument installation take?

Installation time can vary based on the monument’s size and design, but our team ensures every piece
is installed carefully and securely to prevent future shifting or movement. We handle the entire
process from creation to installation with precision and care. We typically estimate a 4-6 week
turnaround from placing the order to installation.

### Can you restore old inscriptions that are hard to read?

Absolutely. Fletcher Monuments specializes in restoring aged or weathered lettering. Our team uses
expert engraving and etching techniques to renew inscriptions and bring clarity back to monuments
without damaging the original stone.

### We are a Pretoria based company with a showroom in Northcliff Johannesburg, but we install
### Country Wide

### Tombstones are manufactured per order.

### **Please note that prices is work out on standard a size.**

Some cemeteries require different sizes according to their standards and additional charges may
apply.

Should you require oversized tombstones you will have to specify it please?

**Prices also excludes accessories like flower pots, photos and stoops.**

**Foundations are strongly advised** as they are crucial as a base and prevents the tombstone from
collapsing or falling over. Foundation sizes can be given to clients if they want to build them
themselves or we can also assist with stoops at additional costs of R2 500 for flat foundation, R6
500 for 3 layer face bricks or R8 500 for 2 layer Sandstone foundations.

La prima azienda in assoluto a proporre
**morse modulari di precisione** per macchine utensili !

**I nostri prodotti più venduti**

### Zero Point System

**Preciso, rapido e sicuro**


Sistema di posizionamento ed ancoraggio istantaneo, la soluzione ideale per il serraggio preciso,
rapido e sicuro di attrezzature e particolari

### Teste Angolari Classic

**Cono e Albero Integrali**


Ideali per Foratura, Fresatura e Maschiatura, linea integrale, più di 250 modelli disponibili

### Teste Angolari Evolution

**Più coni intercambiabili**


Un investimento che si ripaga velocemente, linea modulare, più di 100 modelli disponibili

### Motorizzati

**Potenzia la produttività**


Più di 1000 modelli disponibili, anche con la nuova linea performance

### Morse STD

**La più diffusa al mondo!**


Il trinomio perfetto! Convenienza, qualità e versatilità

### Morse CompactGrip

**3 Morse in 1 Serraggio**


Non solo per centri di lavoro a 5 assi, racchiude compattezza, rigidità e precisione in una sola
morsa

### Morse 5G

**Eleva la tua lavorazione**


Una tecnologia avanzata per centri a 5 assi, il gruppo vite vicino alla zona di serraggio ottimizza
la forza e garantisce un serraggio stabile e preciso

### Morse FMS

**Singole, Doppie o Autocentranti**


Un sistema modulare flessibile con centinaia di ganasce disponibili che garantisce estrerma
versatilità

**Simple, fast, versatile, sustainable and reliable**

Many companies today invest in **high-quality, complex machines.** The problem is that programming
them to reach their full **potential** is out of reach, and the company can't remain globally
competitive.

A flexible CAM software is especially critical if you manufacture **geometrically-demanding parts
**in medium to **high quantities,** or multi-channel mill-turn centers ([multi-task machines,
MTM][58]) or sliding headstock lathes**.** You need a solution that fully masters the **complexity**
of the machine and **grows** with your requirements.

GibbsCAM has the necessary **know-how** to provide a **powerful CNC solution **that is easy for
everyone to use, and empowers machines to manufacture even the most complicated parts **quickly,
precisely and reliably**.

*See what is possible with GibbsCAM*

* We have over 40 years' experience in the development of CAM systems for machining.
* We are a full-service provider.
* We provide professional training online, on-site and in our training centers.
* We offer comprehensive support - from analysis and implementation through to post-processor
  development.
* We are part of the [Sandvik][59] group.

* With GibbsCAM you achieve a 75% faster programming speed.
* Software is easy to learn and intuitive to use.
* Allows precise machine simulation for the most complex machines.
* Offers toolpath simulation with collision detection.
* Interoperability with all common CAD systems.

### Get your machinery up to speed
* One software solution covers all your metal-cutting machines.
* GibbsCAM supports an unlimited number of axes with any axis orientation [Multi-Task Machining
  (MTM)][60], and PrimeTurning™.
* You have a proven, error-free library of over 10,000 post-processors at your disposal.
* Our software has a modular structure and can be expanded as required.

GibbsCAM® is cutting-edge CAM software for programming CNC machine tools with the power and
flexibility to make parts the way you want.

[Hero image]

# Secure your competitiveness
# - now and in the future

## WITH THE CNC PROGRAMMING SOFTWARE GIBBSCAM!

[A customer shows how it's done][53]

**Simple, fast, versatile, sustainable and reliable**

Program all your cutting machines with just one software solution - from simple automatic lathes to
complex, multi-channel turn-mill centers and sliding headstock lathes. GibbsCAM pays off! With us…
* increase your [**Productivity**][54]
* maximize your [**Profit**][55]
* secure your [**Future**][56]

[GibbsCAM Copilot hero image]

## GibbsCAM Copilot
## Integrated AI Support

[GibbsCAM Copilot][57]

## Is your machinery doing the job?

Many companies today invest in **high-quality, complex machines.** The problem is that programming
them to reach their full **potential** is out of reach, and the company can't remain globally
competitive.

A flexible CAM software is especially critical if you manufacture **geometrically-demanding parts
**in medium to **high quantities,** or multi-channel mill-turn centers ([multi-task machines,
MTM][58]) or sliding headstock lathes**.** You need a solution that fully masters the **complexity**
of the machine and **grows** with your requirements.

GibbsCAM has the necessary **know-how** to provide a **powerful CNC solution **that is easy for
everyone to use, and empowers machines to manufacture even the most complicated parts **quickly,
precisely and reliably**.

*See what is possible with GibbsCAM*

## The GibbsCAM advantages

### Use our know-how
* We have over 40 years' experience in the development of CAM systems for machining.
* We are a full-service provider.
* We provide professional training online, on-site and in our training centers.
* We offer comprehensive support - from analysis and implementation through to post-processor
  development.
* We are part of the [Sandvik][59] group.

### Produce efficiently, precisely and safely
* With GibbsCAM you achieve a 75% faster programming speed.
* Software is easy to learn and intuitive to use.
* Allows precise machine simulation for the most complex machines.
* Offers toolpath simulation with collision detection.
* Interoperability with all common CAD systems.

### Get your machinery up to speed
* One software solution covers all your metal-cutting machines.
* GibbsCAM supports an unlimited number of axes with any axis orientation [Multi-Task Machining
  (MTM)][60], and PrimeTurning™.
* You have a proven, error-free library of over 10,000 post-processors at your disposal.
* Our software has a modular structure and can be expanded as required.

## That's why GibbsCAM pays off!

[Increase productivity]

**Increase productivity **- GibbsCAM is easy to learn and intuitive to use for everyone in your
organization. Fast programming for experienced programmers and quick learning for new users, which
results up to 75% faster programming speed. GibbsCAM allows you to exploit the full potential of
your machine.

[Maximize profits]

**Maximize profits** - Thanks to features such as high-speed machining strategies, precise machine

### About HZX STONE

XIAMEN HONGZHANXING Co., Ltd. has been specialized in stone manufacturing since 1990. Its
headquarters was established in 2005 in Xiamen China, by four members of the Hong family.
With over 30 years' in manufacturing and over 17 years' stone exportation experience, we can manage
any and all aspects of your build to ensure that you get the most suitable materials/stones for your
projects.Whatever you are a wholesaler, builder, retailer, consultant or architect, designer and so
on.
**HZX STONE** offers stone products like tile, slab, cut-to-size, countertop, kitchen top, vanity
top, wall cladding, paving stone, curbstone, mosaic, column, sink, fireplace, sculpture, landscaping
items ... and so on. The materials we use like granite, marble, basalt, slate, sandstone,
travertine, limestone, bluestone, quartzite, terrazzo...etc. 
We constantly strive for innovation in the stone industry; pays high attention to the market trends
and business reform; press close to the customer's needs and creates high-quality diverse products.
The corporate culture of **HZX STONE **is people-oriented, respecting the employees. With this main
attitude, the enterprise form a united, harmonious, friendship, and mutual trust atmosphere. By the
means, it strengthens the teamwork spirit, achieves the value of enterprise and employee, and forms
a strong cohesion and solidarity between the employees. **HZX STONE** works hard together to realize
one goal-- providing the customers the best quality products and services, we hope to be your
long-term partner in China.

financial transaction or milestone. Often called **deal tombstones** or **financial tombstones**,

* Crystal-clear **lucite casting** that embeds logos, text, and 3D objects.
* Durable and shatter-resistant compared to glass or crystal awards.
* Fully customizable shapes and sizes.
* Professional engraving to showcase your transaction details.

success in style.

# Monuments Gagnon - Fabricant de pierres tombales. Des monuments funéraires à votre image

Fabricant de pierres tombales – Vente et installation au Québec et aux États-unis. Découvrez nos
produits funéraires uniques, conçus avec soin pour honorer la mémoire de vos proches.

[Nos produits][25][Nos services][26]

## Votre partenaire pour des souvenirs éternels

Monuments Gagnon accompagne les familles dans la création de pierres tombales uniques et
personnalisées. Alliant tradition et innovation, nous façonnons chaque pierre avec soin. Notre
devoir, vous permettre d’honorer la mémoire de vos êtres chers avec dignité et élégance.

Notre entreprise familiale est un chef de file dans la conception, la fabrication, la restauration
et la gravure de pierre tombale et plaques funéraires. Nous vous offrons également un très large
éventail de dessins pour monuments funéraires, sculptures, médaillons et couleurs de granit. 

[ En apprendre plus sur notre histoire ][27] [ Obtenez un prix ][28]

## Découvrez nos pierres tombales et produits funéraires

Chez Monuments Gagnon, nous offrons une gamme complète de produits funéraires alliant qualité,
personnalisation et respect des traditions. Découvrez nos créations conçues pour honorer la mémoire
de vos proches avec élégance à travers le temps.

[][29]

### **Pierres tombales – Monuments funéraires**

Des monuments en granit personnalisables, conçus pour durer et honorer la mémoire des défunts.

[Voir nos pierres tombales][30]
[][31]

### **Bancs en granit**

****

# MSA - Sustainable Community Development and Infrastructure Solutions

# It’s more than a project. It’s a commitment.

MSA specializes in the sustainable development of communities. We achieve this by building honest,
open relationships that go beyond the project to become a trusted source of expertise and support
for immediate challenges and long-term goals. Big or small, we do whatever it takes to meet each
need, working to make communities stronger
in the process.

[SEE HOW][42]

See what our experience has taught us – and how we’re changing the way our environment is built.

> We’re passionate about improving the way people live, work and play. See our unique point of view
> and discover how it’s helping to make an impact.

July 23, 2026 | Andrew R. Skwor, PE | Agriculture, Funding

## [Technical Service Providers: Your Partners in Navigating Today’s Complex Agricultural
## Landscape][43]

Farmers today are balancing more than crops, livestock, and weather. They are navigating a rapidly
shifting landscape of regulations, funding opportunities, and market pressures that grow more
complex each season. In this environment, the role of a Technical Service Provider (TSP) has evolved
from a helpful resource into a critical partner in long-term farm success….

[More][44]

We offer comprehensive, proven experience to help you shape and improve the world around you.

> You have a vision. And we have the capabilities to make it a reality. Our comprehensive experience
> with community and land development projects of all sizes means that whatever you’re imagining, we
> have the people who know how to make it happen.

### See what we're up to

news

company specializing in mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) engineering design services.

[More][45]

Restoring legacy infrastructure & inspiring new memories at a beloved northwoods youth camp.

[More][46]

Contact us to get the conversation started. And learn more about how MSA can be a trusted partner in
meeting your community or development goals. For survey requests, [please click here to fill out our
survey request form][47].

# NSQ

A realtime distributed messaging platform

[Star][5] [Watch][6]

[Get Started][7]







## Distributed


**NSQ** promotes *distributed* and *decentralized* topologies without single points of failure,
enabling fault tolerance and high availability coupled with a reliable message delivery guarantee.
See [features & guarantees][8].

## Scalable


**NSQ** [scales horizontally][9], without any centralized brokers. Built-in discovery simplifies the
addition of nodes to the cluster. Supports both pub-sub and load-balanced message delivery. It’s
[fast][10], too.

## Ops Friendly


**NSQ** is easy to [configure and deploy][11] and comes bundled with an admin UI. Binaries have no
runtime dependencies and we provide [pre-compiled releases][12] for linux, darwin, freebsd and
windows as well as an official [Docker image][13].

## Integrated


Official Go and Python libraries are available as well as many community supported libraries for
most major languages (see [client libraries][14]). If you’re interested in [building your own][15],
there’s a [protocol spec][16].

© 2023 NSQ Authors

# [Introducing Private Universe][32]

Uploaded May 2026: Watch the full video with commentary from Liam Finn in the [Private Universe][33]

Welcome good people, wherever you are.

Here’s an invitation to you, our listeners and supporters of Crowded House, to get deeper into how
we make music, to feel more connected to the band and how we operate, and form a community that we
can be a meaningful part of. The space is called [Private Universe][34].

I suppose it’s a reaction to the impersonal nature and transitory feeling of social media, the noise
that gets curated by algorithms. We aim to have a direct line to you, with fresh and exclusive music
and video on Private Universe as well as regular communication from us.

We have just been rehearsing at the beach, jamming and bringing new songs to life. We’re just as
fascinated as ever with the idea of being a band. Music Is Magic… come and join us if you will.

~ Neil

## [無針水光適合你嗎？療程前後的評估與護理重點][17]

Posted on July 18, 2026

現代美容服務已由單次護理，逐漸發展成更重視膚況分析、療程配合與日常保養的完整管理。想進一步了解相關服
務，可參考無針水光，但在選擇任何療程前，仍應根據個人膚況、健康狀態和預算作獨立判斷。本文會從基本概念
、可能好處、注意事項、安全標準和療程後管理等角度，用較容易理解的方式整理重點，協助讀者建立合理預期，
避免只根據廣告名稱或短期優惠作決定。 療程前要檢查甚麼
接受療程前應先確認肌膚沒有明顯破損、感染、嚴重過敏或急性發炎。近期若曾進行激光、煥膚、微針或高濃度酸
類護理，也應告知美容師，以免在皮膚屏障尚未恢復時再受刺激。對香料、防腐劑或特定活性成分敏感的人，最好
先查看產品配方或進行局部測試。 無針水光是甚麼
無針水光通常指不使用針具，透過導入儀器、氣壓、超聲波或其他方式，將補濕成分帶到皮膚表層或提升吸收效果
的護理。其主要目的多為改善乾燥、粗糙、缺水和妝容不貼服。不同美容院使用的技術和產品並不完全相同，因此
應先查詢成分、操作步驟和預期感受。 衛生與安全標準不能忽略
美容環境的整潔程度直接影響整體體驗與安全。療程工具是否妥善消毒、一次性用品是否即用即棄、床單與毛巾是
否乾淨，以及工作人員是否在操作前清潔雙手，都是值得觀察的細節。涉及儀器、能量或皮膚表面處理的服務，更
應由受過訓練的人員按程序進行。可靠的美容院通常會清楚說明禁忌、可能出現的短暫反應和護理方法，而不是只
強調效果。 療程前評估為甚麼重要
任何美容療程都不應只根據廣告圖片或朋友推薦作決定。專業評估通常會先了解膚質、敏感史、日常保養習慣、近
期接受過的療程，以及目前最想改善的問題。即使兩個人都有乾燥、暗沉或輪廓鬆弛，成因和適合的處理方式也可
能完全不同。清楚的諮詢能協助美容師排除不適合的情況，並設定合理期望。消費者亦應主動說明正在使用的藥物
、酸類產品或曾出現的不良反應，避免因資訊不足而增加刺激或恢復期。 療程前後的生活安排
療程前數天可減少使用刺激性去角質產品，並保持正常保濕。完成後應避免高溫桑拿、長時間曝曬、劇烈摩擦或立
即使用濃度高的活性成分。若準備出席重要活動，最好預留足夠時間，因為即使無針療程較溫和，個別人士仍可能
出現短暫泛紅。 建立合理效果預期
美容療程可以改善膚況、提升保濕感或令外觀更細緻，但通常不能一次解決所有問題。效果會受到年齡、膚質、生
活習慣、護理頻率和個人反應影響。有些改善可在療程後較快感受到，例如柔滑度和水潤感；另一些變化則需要數
星期甚至多次療程才較明顯。若機構以保證、永久或一次見效作主要賣點，消費者應保持審慎。 補濕效果與限制
無針水光的優勢通常是舒適度較高、恢復時間較短，完成後可能感到皮膚更柔軟、水潤和有光澤。然而，這類療程
主要針對缺水與表面狀態，並不能治療所有暗沉、毛孔或色斑問題。若肌膚長期乾燥是由濕疹、荷爾蒙或其他健康
因素引起，仍需要適當醫療評估。 如何評估價格與療程價值
價格是選擇美容服務的重要因素，但不應成為唯一標準。較低價格可能只是首次體驗價，也可能不包括後續護理、
指定部位或必要產品；較高價格亦不一定代表效果更好。消費者應詢問收費包含甚麼、是否需要購買套票、每次療
程相隔多久，以及中途停止是否有退款或轉讓安排。先了解完整成本，才能避免在壓力下作出超出預算的決定。
療程後護理決定維持時間
完成療程不代表護理已經結束。皮膚在接受清潔、導入、能量或其他處理後，可能需要一段時間恢復穩定。一般而
言，應避免立即使用刺激性酸類、磨砂產品或高濃度活性成分，並加強保濕及防曬。若出現持續紅腫、灼熱、痕癢
或其他不尋常反應，應盡快聯絡服務機構或尋求專業意見。良好的睡眠、飲水和穩定作息也會影響效果。
日常保養如何配合專業療程
專業療程只是整體護膚計劃的一部分，日常清潔、保濕和防曬仍然是維持膚況的基礎。選擇產品時不必一味追求高
濃度或多步驟，應以溫和、穩定和適合自己為原則。若剛完成療程，可暫時簡化保養程序，避免同時加入多種新產
品，這樣較容易觀察皮膚反應。定期記錄乾燥、出油、泛紅和色素變化，也能在下次諮詢時提供更準確的資訊。長
期而言，規律作息、充足飲水、均衡飲食和減少過度日曬，往往比頻繁更換療程更能支持肌膚穩定。 結論

## [無針水光適合你嗎？療程前後的評估與護理重點][17]

Posted on July 18, 2026

現代美容服務已由單次護理，逐漸發展成更重視膚況分析、療程配合與日常保養的完整管理。想進一步了解相關服
務，可參考無針水光，但在選擇任何療程前，仍應根據個人膚況、健康狀態和預算作獨立判斷。本文會從基本概念
、可能好處、注意事項、安全標準和療程後管理等角度，用較容易理解的方式整理重點，協助讀者建立合理預期，
避免只根據廣告名稱或短期優惠作決定。 療程前要檢查甚麼
接受療程前應先確認肌膚沒有明顯破損、感染、嚴重過敏或急性發炎。近期若曾進行激光、煥膚、微針或高濃度酸
類護理，也應告知美容師，以免在皮膚屏障尚未恢復時再受刺激。對香料、防腐劑或特定活性成分敏感的人，最好
先查看產品配方或進行局部測試。 無針水光是甚麼
無針水光通常指不使用針具，透過導入儀器、氣壓、超聲波或其他方式，將補濕成分帶到皮膚表層或提升吸收效果
的護理。其主要目的多為改善乾燥、粗糙、缺水和妝容不貼服。不同美容院使用的技術和產品並不完全相同，因此
應先查詢成分、操作步驟和預期感受。 衛生與安全標準不能忽略
美容環境的整潔程度直接影響整體體驗與安全。療程工具是否妥善消毒、一次性用品是否即用即棄、床單與毛巾是
否乾淨，以及工作人員是否在操作前清潔雙手，都是值得觀察的細節。涉及儀器、能量或皮膚表面處理的服務，更
應由受過訓練的人員按程序進行。可靠的美容院通常會清楚說明禁忌、可能出現的短暫反應和護理方法，而不是只
強調效果。 療程前評估為甚麼重要
任何美容療程都不應只根據廣告圖片或朋友推薦作決定。專業評估通常會先了解膚質、敏感史、日常保養習慣、近
期接受過的療程，以及目前最想改善的問題。即使兩個人都有乾燥、暗沉或輪廓鬆弛，成因和適合的處理方式也可
能完全不同。清楚的諮詢能協助美容師排除不適合的情況，並設定合理期望。消費者亦應主動說明正在使用的藥物
、酸類產品或曾出現的不良反應，避免因資訊不足而增加刺激或恢復期。 療程前後的生活安排
療程前數天可減少使用刺激性去角質產品，並保持正常保濕。完成後應避免高溫桑拿、長時間曝曬、劇烈摩擦或立
即使用濃度高的活性成分。若準備出席重要活動，最好預留足夠時間，因為即使無針療程較溫和，個別人士仍可能
出現短暫泛紅。 建立合理效果預期
美容療程可以改善膚況、提升保濕感或令外觀更細緻，但通常不能一次解決所有問題。效果會受到年齡、膚質、生
活習慣、護理頻率和個人反應影響。有些改善可在療程後較快感受到，例如柔滑度和水潤感；另一些變化則需要數
星期甚至多次療程才較明顯。若機構以保證、永久或一次見效作主要賣點，消費者應保持審慎。 補濕效果與限制

指定部位或必要產品；較高價格亦不一定代表效果更好。消費者應詢問收費包含甚麼、是否需要購買套票、每次療
程相隔多久，以及中途停止是否有退款或轉讓安排。先了解完整成本，才能避免在壓力下作出超出預算的決定。

言，應避免立即使用刺激性酸類、磨砂產品或高濃度活性成分，並加強保濕及防曬。若出現持續紅腫、灼熱、痕癢
或其他不尋常反應，應盡快聯絡服務機構或尋求專業意見。良好的睡眠、飲水和穩定作息也會影響效果。

濃度或多步驟，應以溫和、穩定和適合自己為原則。若剛完成療程，可暫時簡化保養程序，避免同時加入多種新產
品，這樣較容易觀察皮膚反應。定期記錄乾燥、出油、泛紅和色素變化，也能在下次諮詢時提供更準確的資訊。長
期而言，規律作息、充足飲水、均衡飲食和減少過度日曬，往往比頻繁更換療程更能支持肌膚穩定。 結論
總結而言，選擇美容服務應以安全、適合度和長期管理為核心，而不是只追求即時效果。進行療程前應先確認服務
內容、產品成分、儀器用途、收費和可能反應，並保留足夠時間考慮，而不是在推銷壓力下即時購買套票。療程後
則要按照建議做好保濕、防曬和觀察，如出現持續不適應及早求助。只有把專業療程與穩定的日常保養配合，才更
有機會維持自然、健康和長久的膚況。

## [無針水光適合你嗎？療程前後的評估與護理重點][17]

Posted on July 18, 2026

現代美容服務已由單次護理，逐漸發展成更重視膚況分析、療程配合與日常保養的完整管理。想進一步了解相關服
務，可參考無針水光，但在選擇任何療程前，仍應根據個人膚況、健康狀態和預算作獨立判斷。本文會從基本概念
、可能好處、注意事項、安全標準和療程後管理等角度，用較容易理解的方式整理重點，協助讀者建立合理預期，
避免只根據廣告名稱或短期優惠作決定。 療程前要檢查甚麼
接受療程前應先確認肌膚沒有明顯破損、感染、嚴重過敏或急性發炎。近期若曾進行激光、煥膚、微針或高濃度酸
類護理，也應告知美容師，以免在皮膚屏障尚未恢復時再受刺激。對香料、防腐劑或特定活性成分敏感的人，最好
先查看產品配方或進行局部測試。 無針水光是甚麼
無針水光通常指不使用針具，透過導入儀器、氣壓、超聲波或其他方式，將補濕成分帶到皮膚表層或提升吸收效果
的護理。其主要目的多為改善乾燥、粗糙、缺水和妝容不貼服。不同美容院使用的技術和產品並不完全相同，因此
應先查詢成分、操作步驟和預期感受。 衛生與安全標準不能忽略
美容環境的整潔程度直接影響整體體驗與安全。療程工具是否妥善消毒、一次性用品是否即用即棄、床單與毛巾是
否乾淨，以及工作人員是否在操作前清潔雙手，都是值得觀察的細節。涉及儀器、能量或皮膚表面處理的服務，更
應由受過訓練的人員按程序進行。可靠的美容院通常會清楚說明禁忌、可能出現的短暫反應和護理方法，而不是只
強調效果。 療程前評估為甚麼重要
任何美容療程都不應只根據廣告圖片或朋友推薦作決定。專業評估通常會先了解膚質、敏感史、日常保養習慣、近
期接受過的療程，以及目前最想改善的問題。即使兩個人都有乾燥、暗沉或輪廓鬆弛，成因和適合的處理方式也可
能完全不同。清楚的諮詢能協助美容師排除不適合的情況，並設定合理期望。消費者亦應主動說明正在使用的藥物
、酸類產品或曾出現的不良反應，避免因資訊不足而增加刺激或恢復期。 療程前後的生活安排
療程前數天可減少使用刺激性去角質產品，並保持正常保濕。完成後應避免高溫桑拿、長時間曝曬、劇烈摩擦或立
即使用濃度高的活性成分。若準備出席重要活動，最好預留足夠時間，因為即使無針療程較溫和，個別人士仍可能
出現短暫泛紅。 建立合理效果預期
美容療程可以改善膚況、提升保濕感或令外觀更細緻，但通常不能一次解決所有問題。效果會受到年齡、膚質、生
活習慣、護理頻率和個人反應影響。有些改善可在療程後較快感受到，例如柔滑度和水潤感；另一些變化則需要數
星期甚至多次療程才較明顯。若機構以保證、永久或一次見效作主要賣點，消費者應保持審慎。 補濕效果與限制
無針水光的優勢通常是舒適度較高、恢復時間較短，完成後可能感到皮膚更柔軟、水潤和有光澤。然而，這類療程
主要針對缺水與表面狀態，並不能治療所有暗沉、毛孔或色斑問題。若肌膚長期乾燥是由濕疹、荷爾蒙或其他健康
因素引起，仍需要適當醫療評估。 如何評估價格與療程價值
價格是選擇美容服務的重要因素，但不應成為唯一標準。較低價格可能只是首次體驗價，也可能不包括後續護理、
指定部位或必要產品；較高價格亦不一定代表效果更好。消費者應詢問收費包含甚麼、是否需要購買套票、每次療
程相隔多久，以及中途停止是否有退款或轉讓安排。先了解完整成本，才能避免在壓力下作出超出預算的決定。

言，應避免立即使用刺激性酸類、磨砂產品或高濃度活性成分，並加強保濕及防曬。若出現持續紅腫、灼熱、痕癢
或其他不尋常反應，應盡快聯絡服務機構或尋求專業意見。良好的睡眠、飲水和穩定作息也會影響效果。
日常保養如何配合專業療程
專業療程只是整體護膚計劃的一部分，日常清潔、保濕和防曬仍然是維持膚況的基礎。選擇產品時不必一味追求高

期而言，規律作息、充足飲水、均衡飲食和減少過度日曬，往往比頻繁更換療程更能支持肌膚穩定。 結論
總結而言，選擇美容服務應以安全、適合度和長期管理為核心，而不是只追求即時效果。進行療程前應先確認服務
內容、產品成分、儀器用途、收費和可能反應，並保留足夠時間考慮，而不是在推銷壓力下即時購買套票。療程後
則要按照建議做好保濕、防曬和觀察，如出現持續不適應及早求助。只有把專業療程與穩定的日常保養配合，才更
有機會維持自然、健康和長久的膚況。

At Objective, Investment Banking & Valuation, our firm’s name embodies our core mission: to help
business owners achieve their objectives. 

Since our founding in 2006, we have specialized in advising closely-held middle market businesses
within our industries of focus. Our proven method leverages deep industry expertise and
sophisticated strategies designed to maximize the value of our client’s businesses.

## PAIASTONE Delivers Quality You Can See and Trust

**PAIASTONE** is a professional stone company with over 20 years of experience in the natural stone
industry. Based in Xiamen, China, PAIASTONE integrates quarry resources, production, design, and
export to serve global clients across more than 60 countries. We specialize in luxury stone projects
including **churches, hotels, villas, and commercial buildings**, providing complete solutions from
design drawing review, material selection, processing, quality control to on-site installation
guidance. With factories equipped with advanced China & Italian machinery and a strong supply chain
from global stone quarries, **PAIASTONE **ensures premium quality, rich material variety, and stable
delivery. Our brand name “PAIA” originates from the four great oceans (Pacific, Atlantic, Indian,
Arctic) — symbolizing our global vision and commitment to connecting the world through stone.

## PAIASTONE Delivers Quality You Can See and Trust

**PAIASTONE** is a professional stone company with over 20 years of experience in the natural stone
industry. Based in Xiamen, China, PAIASTONE integrates quarry resources, production, design, and
export to serve global clients across more than 60 countries. We specialize in luxury stone projects
including **churches, hotels, villas, and commercial buildings**, providing complete solutions from
design drawing review, material selection, processing, quality control to on-site installation
guidance. With factories equipped with advanced China & Italian machinery and a strong supply chain
from global stone quarries, **PAIASTONE **ensures premium quality, rich material variety, and stable
delivery. Our brand name “PAIA” originates from the four great oceans (Pacific, Atlantic, Indian,
Arctic) — symbolizing our global vision and commitment to connecting the world through stone.

# Recognition That Reflects The Achievement

Polaris Custom Awards designs and produces custom deal toys, financial tombstones and recognition
pieces that commemorate transactions, milestones and achievements through thoughtful design and
exceptional craftsmanship with purpose-built execution.

From mergers and acquisitions to fund closings, FDA approvals, real estate developments and employee
recognition, we help clients create pieces people actually keep, display and remember, for long-term
and lasting effect.

[ VIEW GALLERY ][51]
[ GET STARTED ][52]

# Experience Matters

Recognition projects and small batch custom manufacturing can be surprisingly complex.

Balancing symbolism, materials, budgets, production methods and event dates requires experience.
Polaris helps clients navigate that process from concept through delivery.

#### Creative Expertise

Work directly with experienced designers who every aspect of deal toys, materials and custom
manufacturing.

#### Direct Access

No layers of account managers or catalog salespeople. You'll work directly with the people
developing the concepts.

#### Material Mastery

Lucite, crystal, resin, metal, embedded objects and mixed-material assemblies, our experts have done
it all.

#### Thoughtful Design

Beautiful concepts are important, but so are manufacturability, timing and presentation. We design
pieces to be produced reliably and delivered on time.

[Bronze cowboy rider sculpture mounted on wood base with metal plaque, Frederic Remington inspired
commemorative deal marker emphasizing sculptural craftsmanship and permanence.]
[Resin miniature semiconductor fabrication plant with cranes and facility details.]
[Custom deal toy inspired by Washington Square Arch featuring a detailed architectural model mounted
on a faceted crystal platform.]
[Custom Dutch windmill deal toy with spinning blades and resin tulips mounted on green marble base
with crystal panel backdrop]
[Custom recognition award featuring a cast metal tree sculpture mounted on a natural wood base.]
[Riding lawn mower model on grass base with landscape photo backdrop]
[Layered clear and frosted lucite panels mounted on base forming abstract award.]
[Black rotating constellation globe mounted on stone base with etched star maps representing global
reach and strategic vision in executive deal toy design.]
[ [Modern architectural building model financial tombstone with blue structural elements.] ][53]
[Custom deal toy celebrating a multifamily development with full-color building imagery and clear
acrylic construction.]
[gold-bar-lucite-financial-award.jpg]
[Custom dairy industry deal toy featuring a hand-painted resin Holstein cow mounted on a textured
base with translucent blue acrylic.]

# Designed with Purpose and Meaning

The most memorable recognition pieces do more than commemorate a transaction, milestone, or
achievement. They are thoughtfully designed to capture the significance of what was accomplished and
the people who made it happen.

Polaris creates custom recognition pieces for organizations celebrating important transactions,
milestones and accomplishments.

* Mergers & Acquisitions
* Fund Closings
* IPOs
* Capital Raises
* Portfolio Exits
* Debt Financings

### Milestones
* FDA Approvals
* Clinical Milestones
* Product Launches
* Groundbreakings
* Project Completions

### Recognition
* Leadership Awards
* Employee Milestones
* Strategic Partnerships
* Retirement Recognition
* Sales Achievements
* Industry Honors

Polaris Custom Awards designs and produces custom deal toys, financial tombstones and recognition
pieces that commemorate transactions, milestones and achievements through thoughtful design and
exceptional craftsmanship with purpose-built execution.

From mergers and acquisitions to fund closings, FDA approvals, real estate developments and employee
recognition, we help clients create pieces people actually keep, display and remember, for long-term
and lasting effect.

Recognition projects and small batch custom manufacturing can be surprisingly complex.

Balancing symbolism, materials, budgets, production methods and event dates requires experience.
Polaris helps clients navigate that process from concept through delivery.

Since our inception, we have been a part of various infrastructure projects spread across the world.
Our beautiful granite remains the first and foremost choice of granite importers worldwide who come
back to us for their needs of granite. We focus not just on supplying durable granite to B2B granite
importers, but we strive to build long-term and fruitful relationships with our clients by helping
them get what they need.

**Our values are**:
* Trust
* Integrated Work Approach
* Value-based commitment
* Superior Quality

It is our unwavering commitment to manufacturing and exporting high-quality granite that gives us an
edge in the granite export sector. Not only do we provide granite slabs and countertops, but we also
provide project-specific granite articles to granite importers in countries like the USA, UK,
Canada, Europe, UAE, Australia, China, Russia, and others.

### 25 Years of Industry Expertise

Established in 2000, Regatta Granites India is a globally-recognized granite manufacturer & 
exporter in India and provides all types of Indian granite at competitive rates.

### Widest Product Range

At Regatta Granites India, we have more than 100 types of granite in our product portfolio. We have
both South Indian Granite and North Indian Granite that are in huge demand all across the world. In
addition, we are experts in exporting granite rough blocks, gangsaw slabs, cutter slabs, thresholds,
window sills, treads, monuments, countertops, worktops, and others.

### Ethical Sourcing & Manufacturing

We are a socially responsible granite manufacturer and exporter. We employ ethical ways of sourcing
and manufacturing granite. This ensures little or no harm to the environment. This is another reason
why global B2B granite importers prefer to import granite from us.

The use of granite has become a new norm in the construction industry due to its aesthetic appeal,
high durability, and availability of different colors. At Regatta Granites India, we commit to
deliver superior quality Indian granite to architects, construction contractors, granite importers,
and others at factory rates.

Since our inception, we have been a part of various infrastructure projects spread across the world.
Our beautiful granite remains the first and foremost choice of granite importers worldwide who come
back to us for their needs of granite. We focus not just on supplying durable granite to B2B granite
importers, but we strive to build long-term and fruitful relationships with our clients by helping
them get what they need.

**Our values are**:
* Trust
* Integrated Work Approach
* Value-based commitment
* Superior Quality

It is our unwavering commitment to manufacturing and exporting high-quality granite that gives us an
edge in the granite export sector. Not only do we provide granite slabs and countertops, but we also
provide project-specific granite articles to granite importers in countries like the USA, UK,
Canada, Europe, UAE, Australia, China, Russia, and others.

### 25 Years of Industry Expertise

Established in 2000, Regatta Granites India is a globally-recognized granite manufacturer & 
exporter in India and provides all types of Indian granite at competitive rates.

### Widest Product Range

At Regatta Granites India, we have more than 100 types of granite in our product portfolio. We have
both South Indian Granite and North Indian Granite that are in huge demand all across the world. In
addition, we are experts in exporting granite rough blocks, gangsaw slabs, cutter slabs, thresholds,
window sills, treads, monuments, countertops, worktops, and others.

### Ethical Sourcing & Manufacturing

We are a socially responsible granite manufacturer and exporter. We employ ethical ways of sourcing
and manufacturing granite. This ensures little or no harm to the environment. This is another reason
why global B2B granite importers prefer to import granite from us.

The use of granite has become a new norm in the construction industry due to its aesthetic appeal,
high durability, and availability of different colors. At Regatta Granites India, we commit to
deliver superior quality Indian granite to architects, construction contractors, granite importers,
and others at factory rates.

# [About Company][55]

Rising Source Stone is as a direct manufacturer and supplier of natural marble, granite, onyx,
agate, quartzite, travertine, slate, artificial stone, and other natural stone materials. Quarry,
Factory, Sales, Designs and Installation are among the Group’s departments. The Group was founded in
2016 and now owns five quarries in China. Our factory has a variety of automation equipment, such as
cut blocks, slabs, tiles, waterjet, stairs, counter tops, table tops, columns, skirting, fountains,
statues, mosaic tiles, and so on, and it employs over 200 skilled workers can produce at least 1.5
million square meters of tile per year.

## ABOUT US

Reliable, Efficient and our Global Association in the last 30 years

We at RSVS Granites manufacture and export granite Monuments, Tombstones, Headstones, Mausoleums,
Sculptures and other products. We have been in the business for the past 20 years which makes us one
of the best granite monuments manufacturers in India and granite monuments exporters globally. We
have been associated with the German market mainly.   Being a completely export-based company, we
operate to International Standards. 

 

With years of expertise and experience, RSVS Granites is proud to be regarded as one of the
best-quality granite monument manufacturers in India. Every decision is inspired by our main
mission, which is to provide the highest quality granite products. Having worked with German quality
for more than 30 years now, it has become more of a habit than an act.

Based out of South India, our Facility is located close to the Chennai Port, making it easy for us
in terms of logistics. We also provide extensive services to our customers, like Designing,
Drawings, 3D models and Pricing. With a team of 20+ in the corporate office, we provide continuous
support throughout the day  and a wide range of other facilities to make business with us the easy. 

 

 We invite you to browse through our Products and contact us with your queries.

## ABOUT US

Reliable, Efficient and our Global Association in the last 30 years

We at RSVS Granites manufacture and export granite Monuments, Tombstones, Headstones, Mausoleums,
Sculptures and other products. We have been in the business for the past 20 years which makes us one
of the best granite monuments manufacturers in India and granite monuments exporters globally. We
have been associated with the German market mainly.   Being a completely export-based company, we
operate to International Standards. 

 

With years of expertise and experience, RSVS Granites is proud to be regarded as one of the
best-quality granite monument manufacturers in India. Every decision is inspired by our main
mission, which is to provide the highest quality granite products. Having worked with German quality
for more than 30 years now, it has become more of a habit than an act.

Based out of South India, our Facility is located close to the Chennai Port, making it easy for us
in terms of logistics. We also provide extensive services to our customers, like Designing,
Drawings, 3D models and Pricing. With a team of 20+ in the corporate office, we provide continuous
support throughout the day  and a wide range of other facilities to make business with us the easy.

## Frequently Asked Questions On Memorials
* ### What are the first steps I need to take to get started on a memorial?
  
  1. Purchase a lot from the cemetery. Be sure that the plot you select meets your memorial
  requirement, i.e., size, color, design, etc.
  
  2. [Contact us][85] so we can guide you through the [rules and regulations][86] that are in place
  for the cemetery/section of the plot. It is helpful to have the location and deed to confirm
  cemetery rules
  
  3. Decide on memorial size/shape/color/design ideas
* ### How much does a granite memorial cost?
  
  The cost of a memorial can vary greatly depending on several factors, such as the type of
  memorial, the size, the materials used, the difficulty of making it, the location, and any
  additional features or customization.
  
  
   *Some common types of memorials include:*  
  
  Headstones/Lawn-Level Markers: [Headstones][87] are typically made of [granite][88], marble, or
  [bronze][89] and can cost anywhere from a few hundred to several thousand dollars.  
  
  
  [Plaques][90]/Reflection Stones: Plaques and reflection stones are often made of metal or stone
  and can be affixed to a wall, bench, or other structure. Prices can range from a few hundred to a
  few thousand dollars.  
  
  
  Monuments: Monuments are larger memorials that can include sculptures, statues, or other artistic
  elements. Prices can range from several thousand to tens of thousands of dollars.  
  
  
   *In addition to the type of memorial, other factors that can affect the cost include:*  
  
  Size: Larger memorials generally cost more than smaller ones.  
  
  
  [Materials][91]: The cost of materials can vary widely depending on the type and quality of the
  material used. Granites come from all over the world, and the availability of resources varies the
  cost significantly.  
  
  
  Location: The cost of a memorial can also depend on where it will be placed. For example, a
  cemetery may charge fees for installing a headstone or monument. You must follow the rules and
  regulations of the cemetery.  
  
  
  Customization: If you want to add personalized features to a memorial, such as an engraved message
  or a unique design, this can sometimes increase the cost. Shevchenko Monuments is unique in that
  we allow for a wide range of personalization options that do not affect the cost of the memorial.
   
  
  Overall, the cost of a memorial can range from a few hundred dollars to tens of thousands of
  dollars, depending on the factors listed above. It’s best to [consult with a professional][92] in
  the memorial industry for a more accurate estimate based on your specific needs and preferences.
* ### How long is the process to get a stone set in the cemetery?
  
  The process typically spans 4 to 6 months, influenced by several key factors, including shipping,
  cemetery permits, and the level of customization. If the stone is not readily available, it may
  need to be sourced from quarries in Vermont or abroad. Furthermore, the cemetery must approve the
  permit, and a foundation must be poured prior to the stone being set. The complexity of the
  customization also plays a significant role— the more intricate the design, the longer the
  timeline may extend.
* ### What are the most important elements of telling my loved one's story?
  
  Telling the story of your loved one on their memorial can be a meaningful and rewarding way to
  honor and remember them. The most important elements of telling their story may vary depending on
  your loved one’s personality, interests, and achievements, as well as the tone and style of the
  memorial. However, some common elements that you may want to consider including are:
  
   **Personal background: Details about your loved one’s upbringing, family, and childhood.**  
  
   **Significant life events: Important milestones in your loved one’s life, such as their
  education, career, marriage, and children.**  
  
   **Achievements and contributions: Your loved one’s accomplishments, talents, and interests, as
  well as any contributions they made to their community or society.**  
  
   **Character and personality: Your loved one’s unique personality traits, values, and beliefs.**  
  
   **Relationships: Stories and memories about your loved one’s relationships with family, friends,
  and colleagues, as well as any special connections they had with others.**  
  
   **Legacy: The greater impact your loved one had on the people and world around them, as well as
  how they will be remembered.**  
  
  Ultimately, the most important element of telling your loved one’s story on their memorial is to
  capture the essence of who they were and what they meant to those who knew and loved them. [Your
  options are endless][93]; the only limit is your imagination. Our professional staff can help
  guide you through the process.

We deeply understand the hardships families face when seeking our services, and it is our mission to

## Frequently Asked Questions On Memorials
* ### What are the first steps I need to take to get started on a memorial?
  
  1. Purchase a lot from the cemetery. Be sure that the plot you select meets your memorial
  requirement, i.e., size, color, design, etc.
  
  2. [Contact us][85] so we can guide you through the [rules and regulations][86] that are in place
  for the cemetery/section of the plot. It is helpful to have the location and deed to confirm
  cemetery rules
  
  3. Decide on memorial size/shape/color/design ideas
* ### How much does a granite memorial cost?
  
  The cost of a memorial can vary greatly depending on several factors, such as the type of
  memorial, the size, the materials used, the difficulty of making it, the location, and any
  additional features or customization.
  
  
   *Some common types of memorials include:*  
  
  Headstones/Lawn-Level Markers: [Headstones][87] are typically made of [granite][88], marble, or
  [bronze][89] and can cost anywhere from a few hundred to several thousand dollars.  
  
  
  [Plaques][90]/Reflection Stones: Plaques and reflection stones are often made of metal or stone
  and can be affixed to a wall, bench, or other structure. Prices can range from a few hundred to a
  few thousand dollars.  
  
  
  Monuments: Monuments are larger memorials that can include sculptures, statues, or other artistic
  elements. Prices can range from several thousand to tens of thousands of dollars.  
  
  
   *In addition to the type of memorial, other factors that can affect the cost include:*  
  
  Size: Larger memorials generally cost more than smaller ones.  
  
  
  [Materials][91]: The cost of materials can vary widely depending on the type and quality of the
  material used. Granites come from all over the world, and the availability of resources varies the
  cost significantly.  
  
  
  Location: The cost of a memorial can also depend on where it will be placed. For example, a
  cemetery may charge fees for installing a headstone or monument. You must follow the rules and
  regulations of the cemetery.  
  
  
  Customization: If you want to add personalized features to a memorial, such as an engraved message
  or a unique design, this can sometimes increase the cost. Shevchenko Monuments is unique in that
  we allow for a wide range of personalization options that do not affect the cost of the memorial.
   
  
  Overall, the cost of a memorial can range from a few hundred dollars to tens of thousands of
  dollars, depending on the factors listed above. It’s best to [consult with a professional][92] in
  the memorial industry for a more accurate estimate based on your specific needs and preferences.
* ### How long is the process to get a stone set in the cemetery?
  
  The process typically spans 4 to 6 months, influenced by several key factors, including shipping,
  cemetery permits, and the level of customization. If the stone is not readily available, it may
  need to be sourced from quarries in Vermont or abroad. Furthermore, the cemetery must approve the
  permit, and a foundation must be poured prior to the stone being set. The complexity of the
  customization also plays a significant role— the more intricate the design, the longer the
  timeline may extend.
* ### What are the most important elements of telling my loved one's story?
  
  Telling the story of your loved one on their memorial can be a meaningful and rewarding way to
  honor and remember them. The most important elements of telling their story may vary depending on
  your loved one’s personality, interests, and achievements, as well as the tone and style of the
  memorial. However, some common elements that you may want to consider including are:
  
   **Personal background: Details about your loved one’s upbringing, family, and childhood.**  
  
   **Significant life events: Important milestones in your loved one’s life, such as their
  education, career, marriage, and children.**  
  
   **Achievements and contributions: Your loved one’s accomplishments, talents, and interests, as
  well as any contributions they made to their community or society.**  
  
   **Character and personality: Your loved one’s unique personality traits, values, and beliefs.**  
  
   **Relationships: Stories and memories about your loved one’s relationships with family, friends,
  and colleagues, as well as any special connections they had with others.**  
  
   **Legacy: The greater impact your loved one had on the people and world around them, as well as
  how they will be remembered.**  
  
  Ultimately, the most important element of telling your loved one’s story on their memorial is to
  capture the essence of who they were and what they meant to those who knew and loved them. [Your
  options are endless][93]; the only limit is your imagination. Our professional staff can help
  guide you through the process.

# Welcome to Sodo: Your Premier Supplier of Natural and Artificial Stones

From global classics to cutting-edge innovations, find your perfect stone match for any project.
Specializing in Artificial and Natural Stones – Slabs, Countertops, and bespoke solutions for
importers, fabricators, and wholesalers worldwide.

Sodo: Where Your Vision Meets the Mastery of Stone.

[ Get A Quote ][16]

## Sodo Services

Sodo offers specialized services for artificial and natural stone needs, ensuring quality,
customization, and comprehensive support.

[custom-solutions][custom-solutions]

### Custom Solutions

Offering tailor-made stone solutions that align with your project’s unique requirements, ensuring
both aesthetic and functional excellence.

[global-sourcing][global-sourcing]

### Global Sourcing

Access the finest artificial and natural stones from across the globe, complemented by reliable,
prompt logistics for seamless delivery.

[support-advice][support-advice]

### Support & Advice

Benefit from our comprehensive support on stone selection, installation nuances, and upkeep tips to
maximize durability and visual appeal.

## Natural and Artificial Stones Projects

Showcasing our expertise in Artificial and Natural Stone applications across various settings. Our
projects highlight innovation, quality, and custom solutions tailored to each client’s needs.

Stone House Armadale
As a premier natural stone supplier in China, we proudly contributed to our Australian client’s
Armadale project. This three-story Mediterranean retreat features custom-crafted granite, evoking
ancient Grecian charm. The floating granite facade contrasts with the robust 260-tonne shell, while
split-faced cladding and rustic flamed granite paving enhance its elegance. Our exceptional
craftsmanship and architectural detailing transformed this project into a strong, inviting haven. We
look forward to supplying the finest natural stone for your next project.
[Stone House Armadal Project Image][Stone House Armadal Project Image]
Kooyong Road
Our Kooyong Road project in St Kilda showcasesthe prestige of bespoke natural stone. Featuring
family swimming pool, spa, and outdoor area, weused slip-resistant, durable granite for the
poolcoping. Pearl White granite adds elegance andsimplicity, while Aniseed granite provides
strikingcontrast. Inside, large Pearl White tiles seamlesslyblend indoor and outdoor spaces,
creating a clean,contemporary style.
[Kooyong Road Project Image][Kooyong Road Project Image]
Cheltenham
This Cheltenham home renovation blends the charm of its yellow-brick exterior with modern
sophistication. Inside, vaulted ceilings and concrete floors lead to Aston Grey paving and pool
coping. The alfresco area is ideal for entertaining or relaxing by the pool. Bathrooms feature
floor-to-ceiling Aston Grey Granite tiles, smooth and honed inside, flamed outside for slip
resistance. Floating granite vanity units, carved from solid stone, add an elegant touch.
[Cheltenham Project Image][Cheltenham Project Image]
[ View More Details ][17]

poolcoping. Pearl White granite adds elegance andsimplicity, while Aniseed granite provides
strikingcontrast. Inside, large Pearl White tiles seamlesslyblend indoor and outdoor spaces,
creating a clean,contemporary style.
[Kooyong Road Project Image][Kooyong Road Project Image]
Cheltenham
This Cheltenham home renovation blends the charm of its yellow-brick exterior with modern
sophistication. Inside, vaulted ceilings and concrete floors lead to Aston Grey paving and pool
coping. The alfresco area is ideal for entertaining or relaxing by the pool. Bathrooms feature
floor-to-ceiling Aston Grey Granite tiles, smooth and honed inside, flamed outside for slip
resistance. Floating granite vanity units, carved from solid stone, add an elegant touch.

## Who We Are and Why It Matters to Your Business

Stone Discover has been a direct-manufacturer and wholesale exporter of premium granite monuments,
supplying memorial dealers, funeral homes, cemetery suppliers, and wholesale distributors across the
USA and Canada since 1984. We are not a trading company or a middleman. We own and operate our
complete production chain, from granite sourcing at quarry base in Khammam, Telangana, through
manufacturing at our processing facility, to export-grade packaging and direct container shipment.

Every [Cemetery memorial][26] headstones that leaves our facility has been through a documented
quality process, block inspection at source, precision cutting and polishing, multi-point surface
checks, and secure export packaging. With a consistent production capacity for bulk and
container-load orders, we are built for long-term supply partnerships — not one-off transactions. If
you are looking for a granite headstone supplier you can rely on month after month, that is exactly
what we have been doing since 1984.
