## Frequently Asked Questions

## ### Are you a granite headstone manufacturer or trader?

Stone Discover is a direct manufacturer — not a broker, agent, or trading company. We own and
operate our own granite processing and manufacturing facilities in India, sourcing granite blocks
from our quarry base in Khammam, Telangana. Every headstone we export is factory-made by our own
team and shipped directly to our international B2B buyers without any intermediary in the chain.
This means you get manufacturer pricing, direct communication, and full accountability over quality.

## ### Do you supply granite headstones on a wholesale basis?

Yes — wholesale supply is our core business model. We supply granite headstones in bulk to monument
dealers, funeral homes, cemetery suppliers, memorial parks, and wholesale distributors across the
USA, Canada, and other international markets. We work primarily on container-based wholesale orders
and long-term supply contracts. If you are looking for a reliable, recurring supply of granite
headstones at competitive wholesale pricing, we are set up exactly for that.

## ### Which countries do you export granite headstones to?

Our primary export markets are the USA and Canada, where we have established supply relationships
with monument dealers and wholesale distributors. We also export regularly to Australia, the United
Kingdom, Germany, France, Ireland, and New Zealand. For North American buyers, we ship to major
ports including Los Angeles, Houston, New York, and Vancouver. If your market is not listed here,
contact us — we have shipped to over 70 countries and can discuss logistics for most destinations.

## ### Do you manufacture black granite headstones?

Yes. Absolute Black granite headstones are our most exported product line, particularly to the USA
and Canada where black granite is the dominant material in most cemetery markets. Our Absolute Black
granite is sourced from quarries in Telangana and is Grade A monument quality — dense, low-porosity,
with a consistent deep black surface that holds its polish outdoors for decades. We also manufacture
headstones in Steel Grey, Bahama Blue, Imperial Red, Viscount White, and other Indian granite
varieties on request.

## ### What different varieties of Headstones do you offer?

Our full product range includes upright headstones (standard and bevel), angel headstones, flat
grave markers, book headstones, kerb sets, headstone vases, memorial benches, and columbarium units.
All products are available in multiple [granite colors][37] and can be supplied plain (blank) or
with custom engraving. We can also produce bespoke designs — custom shapes, sculpted figures,
religious motifs, and non-standard sizes — on request, with minimum order quantities depending on
the design complexity.

## ### Can you supply granite blank headstones for local engraving?

Yes, and this is one of our most popular services for dealers in the USA and Canada. We supply
polished blank granite headstones — upright, flat, bevel, and slant styles — in standard US and
Canadian cemetery dimensions, ready for local sandblast or laser engraving. Buying blank from us
gives you the cost advantage of Indian manufacturing while retaining full control over the lettering
and personalization process at your end. Contact us for blank headstone pricing and available
dimensions.

## ### What is your minimum order quantity (MOQ)?

Our standard MOQ starts at 10 pieces per design for wholesale orders. For full container (FCL)
orders, we recommend a mixed order of 50 or more pieces across product types to maximise container
efficiency and shipping value. For bespoke or custom-carved designs, higher minimums may apply
depending on the complexity of the fabrication. We are happy to discuss MOQ flexibility for buyers
placing their first order or testing a new product line — reach out and we will find a workable
arrangement.

## ### How are granite headstones packed for export?

Every headstone is packed in a fumigated wooden crate — required for US and Canadian customs
clearance — with internal foam separators, acid-free plastic wrapping around polished surfaces, and
corner protection on all edges. The crating design is tested specifically for FCL and LCL ocean
freight conditions. Polished black granite surfaces are additionally wrapped with acid-free film to
prevent moisture and tannin staining from the wood during long-haul shipping. We have a near-zero
damage rate on delivered shipments as a resu

**Our mission is to:**

Advise, appraise, and advance our Clients’ needs and objectives with regard to selling, acquiring,
or transferring a business enterprise in a professional, confidential, expeditious, and thorough
manner.

## [Seller Services][92]

Selling your business is a major decision! You have devoted your time, money, and energy into
building, running, and operating your business.
[Learn More][93]

## [Veterinary Services][94]

We at the BUSINESS HOUSE, inc. ℠ are experienced in the complex processes of buying, selling, and
valuating a veterinary practice.
[Learn More][95]

## [Valuation Services][96]

Our staff of board certified appraisers conduct our projects under the USAP (United Standards of
Professional Appraisal Practice) guidelines.
[Learn More][97]

## [Buyer Services][98]

Buying a business can be a complicated procedure, from finding the right one to working out all the
details required for a smooth transfer.
[Learn More][99]

# **Sell My Business**

**The Business House** is your trusted Georgia business brokerage, we do everything in our power to
see that you make the most possible profit from selling your company and business. We’ll help
optimize your processes and strategies to improve enterprise performance while focusing on employee
enrichment growth strategy and cash flow analysis. Our goal is always to develop a broad-based,
comprehensive business plan together that takes all considerations into account for future success.
So, no matter what kind of business you have, we’ll make sure it gets the attention and care it
needs to be profitable.

Contact us to run our 54 analytical enhancement study at no cost.

# About Us

Welcome to The Tombstone Factory, where excellence meets craftsmanship. We take pride in our
commitment to delivering superior quality, professional stone installations. With our expertise in
first-grade granite fabrication, precision polishing, and exquisite engraving, we create timeless
pieces that leave a lasting impression. At The Tombstone Factory, we understand that each individual
has unique preferences and varying budgets. That’s why we offer a wide range of options to cater to
every need, ensuring that our services are accessible to all. Our team of skilled artisans is
dedicated to bringing your vision to life, crafting personalized designs that reflect your style and
personality.

As industry leaders, we stay ahead of the curve by constantly staying in tune with the latest trends
and innovations. By blending traditional craftsmanship with contemporary techniques, we create
tombstones that are both timeless and modern, surpassing expectations and setting new standards. For
more information, we invite you to reach out to us via WhatsApp at 082 0631 786 or email us at
thetombstonefactory@icloud.com. Our friendly and knowledgeable team is ready to assist you in any
way they can. To truly appreciate the artistry and quality of our work, we encourage you to visit
our factory showroom located at 7 Cinnamon Rd, Industrial Area, Stanger. Experience the difference

# Jsme přední český výrobce tzv. tombstone.

**Tombstone** (také v počeštěné podobě tombstoun) je luxusní upomínkový předmět, který odkazuje na
významný projekt, událost, nebo slouží jako poděkování či ocenění pro konkrétní osobu nebo tým za
účast na projektu. Ale nejen to, plexisklový tombstone může být též trofejí za nejlepší výsledky,
sloužit k oslavě milníku v kariéře nebo se prezentuje při příležitosti významné obchodní transakce.
Tombstone slouží jako ocenění, trofej, upomínka na významné úspěchy, události, projekty, data,
výročí.

Technicky je tombstone vyrobený pomocí laminace plexiskla. Do transparentního ‘trezoru‘ lze
zalaminovat letáky, reklamní tiskoviny, certifikáty, diplomy, bankovky a jiné ceniny, fotografie,
navštívenky a celou řadu dalších tiskovin. Na tombstone je možné vytvořit fazetu, přidat podstavec,
případně provést další operace dle přání a představ klienta. Základní tvary produktu jsou čtverec,
obdélník a lichoběžník. Ovšem realizace tombstone je možná též dle konkrétního návrhu zákazníka, s
ohledem na technologické možnosti a vlastnosti materiálu.

Naše **výroba tombstone** se vyznačuje vysokou kvalitou zpracování, krátkými dodacími lhůtami a
férovými cenami. [Neváhejte nás kontaktovat][12] s vaší poptávkou nebo s vašimi dotazy.

Konzultace k projektu

Nejste si jisti jak realizovat Váš nápad? Chybí Vám čas či odborné dovednosti pro přípravu
technických nákresů?

Neváhejte nás kontaktovat, nabízíme ZDARMA úvodní konzultace k Vašemu projektu.

[ Kontakty ][13]

Cenová kalkulace

Cena vyráběných produktů se odvíjí od současných cen materiálu.Před uzavřením smlouvy Vám vždy
zdarma zašleme podrobnou a kompletní cenovou kalkulaci.

## TOMBSTONY JSOU VĚČNÉ

Předchozí Další

# Jsme přední český výrobce tzv. tombstone.

**Tombstone** (také v počeštěné podobě tombstoun) je luxusní upomínkový předmět, který odkazuje na
významný projekt, událost, nebo slouží jako poděkování či ocenění pro konkrétní osobu nebo tým za
účast na projektu. Ale nejen to, plexisklový tombstone může být též trofejí za nejlepší výsledky,
sloužit k oslavě milníku v kariéře nebo se prezentuje při příležitosti významné obchodní transakce.
Tombstone slouží jako ocenění, trofej, upomínka na významné úspěchy, události, projekty, data,
výročí.

Technicky je tombstone vyrobený pomocí laminace plexiskla. Do transparentního ‘trezoru‘ lze
zalaminovat letáky, reklamní tiskoviny, certifikáty, diplomy, bankovky a jiné ceniny, fotografie,
navštívenky a celou řadu dalších tiskovin. Na tombstone je možné vytvořit fazetu, přidat podstavec,
případně provést další operace dle přání a představ klienta. Základní tvary produktu jsou čtverec,
obdélník a lichoběžník. Ovšem realizace tombstone je možná též dle konkrétního návrhu zákazníka, s
ohledem na technologické možnosti a vlastnosti materiálu.

Naše **výroba tombstone** se vyznačuje vysokou kvalitou zpracování, krátkými dodacími lhůtami a
férovými cenami. [Neváhejte nás kontaktovat][12] s vaší poptávkou nebo s vašimi dotazy.

Konzultace k projektu

Nejste si jisti jak realizovat Váš nápad? Chybí Vám čas či odborné dovednosti pro přípravu
technických nákresů?

Neváhejte nás kontaktovat, nabízíme ZDARMA úvodní konzultace k Vašemu projektu.

[ Kontakty ][13]

Cenová kalkulace

Cena vyráběných produktů se odvíjí od současných cen materiálu.Před uzavřením smlouvy Vám vždy
zdarma zašleme podrobnou a kompletní cenovou kalkulaci.

## Welcome to Tombstone Distillery

**Born from grit. Aged in silence. Unleashed with fire**.
**Tombstone Whiskey** is built for those who live boldly and drink with purpose. From smooth low-rye
bourbons to high-proof, barrel-strength power, every bottle carries the mark of time, heat, and
unfiltered character. This isn’t just whiskey—it’s a statement.

Smooth, rich, and effortlessly drinkable, this 7-year Low Rye Bourbon delivers warm **caramel and
toffee sweetness** with a soft, lingering finish. Balanced and approachable with just a touch of
spice.

[ Discover Our Low Rye Blend ][22]

Bold and flavorful with a spicy edge, this 7-year High Rye Bourbon opens with **vanilla and
caramel** before building into a **peppery, energetic finish** that rye lovers crave.

[ Discover Our High Rye Blend ][23]

Nearly equal parts corn and rye, this powerful 7-year expression leads with **creamy vanilla**,
rolling into **warm baking spices** and finishing long, dry, and confidently bold.

[ Discover Our Highest Rye Blend ][24]

Bright and commanding, this 8-year reserve bursts with a **citrus-forward nose**, a **juicy
mid-palate**, and a **lively, pepper-charged finish** built for those who like their whiskey with
authority.

[ Discover Our JFG Reserve Blend ][25]

Uncut and unapologetic, this pot-distilled, barrel-proof powerhouse delivers **rich grain, deep
warmth, and a smooth yet fiery spicy finish** with no dilution and zero compromise.

[ Discover Our Cask Strength Blend ][26]

## Born From Grit. Aged In Silence

**Tombstone Whiskey** is built for those who live boldly and drink with purpose. From smooth low-rye
bourbons to high-proof, barrel-strength power, every bottle carries the mark of time, heat, and
unfiltered character. This isn’t just whiskey—it’s a statement.

## Welcome To Tombstone Distillery

## Tombstone, Arizona

Born on the most legendary street in the American West, **Tombstone Distillery** stands on the very
ground where the **1881 Gunfight at the O.K. Corral** made history. From this iconic location at
**325 E. Allen Street**, we craft bold, handcrafted whiskeys that carry the same grit, tension, and
legacy as the town itself.

Our spirits are made with rare, **mineral-rich “Magic Water” drawn from the Cienegas Creek Basin**,
giving every bottle a naturally distinctive character you won’t find anywhere else. Backed by
**exclusive ownership of two private wells**, this irreplaceable resource is protected for
generations to come.

Since **1990**, we’ve been producing small-batch, **Kentucky-style whiskeys** with an uncompromising
dedication to quality—Bourbon, Rye, Single Malt, Blended, Cask, Reserve, and our legendary **Lost
Barrel** releases. No shortcuts. No compromises. Just time, fire, and craftsmanship.

Today, as we expand our historic half-block property directly across from the O.K. Corral, our
mission remains unchanged:
**to preserve the soul of handcrafted whiskey while building a world-class, internationally
recognized brand.**

This isn’t just where whiskey is made.
**This is where legends are poured.**

[

## LOW RYE Bourbon

][27]

**Smooth. Bold. Deadly good.**
* Aged 7 Years
* Amazing Notes Of Caramel & Toffee With A Soft Finish
* 90 Proof | 45% Alc By Vol
* 71% Corn
* 24% Rye
* Amazing Notes Of Caramel & Toffee With A Soft Finish

[

## HIGH RYE Bourbon

][28]

**Bold, Fiery, and Unapologetically Powerful**
* Aged 7 Years
* Notes of Vanilla & Caramel With a Spicy Finish
* 90 Proof | 45% Alc By Vol
* 59% Corn
* 36% Rye
* 5% Barley

[

## HIGHEST RYE Bourbon

][29]

**Untamed, Commanding, and Built For Whiskey Purists**
* Aged 7 Years
* Creamy Vanilla, With Warm Spices and Long Finish
* 90 Proof | 45% Alc By Vol
* 51% Corn
* 49% Rye
* 5% Barley

[

## JFG RESERVE Bourbon

][30]

**Refined, Powerful, and Distinguished Beyond the Ordinary**
* Aged 8 Years
* Citrus Nose, Juicy Palate with Live Peppery Finish
* 100.5 Proof | 50.2% Alc By V

This isn’t just where whiskey is made.
**This is where legends are poured.**

[

## LOW RYE Bourbon

][27]

**Smooth. Bold. Deadly good.**
* Aged 7 Years
* Amazing Notes Of Caramel & Toffee With A Soft Finish
* 90 Proof | 45% Alc By Vol
* 71% Corn
* 24% Rye
* Amazing Notes Of Caramel & Toffee With A Soft Finish

[

## HIGH RYE Bourbon

][28]

**Bold, Fiery, and Unapologetically Powerful**
* Aged 7 Years
* Notes of Vanilla & Caramel With a Spicy Finish
* 90 Proof | 45% Alc By Vol
* 59% Corn
* 36% Rye
* 5% Barley

[

## HIGHEST RYE Bourbon

][29]

**Untamed, Commanding, and Built For Whiskey Purists**
* Aged 7 Years
* Creamy Vanilla, With Warm Spices and Long Finish
* 90 Proof | 45% Alc By Vol
* 51% Corn
* 49% Rye
* 5% Barley

[

## JFG RESERVE Bourbon

][30]

**Refined, Powerful, and Distinguished Beyond the Ordinary**
* Aged 8 Years
* Citrus Nose, Juicy Palate with Live Peppery Finish
* 100.5 Proof | 50.2% Alc By Vol
* 60% Corn
* 36% Rye
* 4% Barley

[

## CASK STRENGTH Bourbon

][31]

**Raw. Unfiltered. Uncompromising**
* Aged 5 Years
* Smooth, Silky with A Slightly Spicy Finish
* 119.2 Proof | 59.6% Alc By Vol
* 60% Corn
* 36% Rye
* 4% Barley
* Aged 8 Years
* Creamy Vanilla, With Warm Spices and Long Finish
* 100.5 Proof | 50.2% Alc By Vol

## More Information

## A Smart Investment

At under $5,000 delivered, the TJ 4200 quickly pays for itself:
-Level 50 monuments in a week... at a labor value of $200 each, that equates to $10,000 in preserved
monuments, and your equipment is paid for.
-Gravel costs about $300 for a 16 ton load, per 700 monuments, averaging $0.43 per monument a
minimal expense for long-term stability.
-Customers across the U.S. and Canada have proven the return on investment, with some surpassing
30,000 monuments- leveled as of 2025 (and growing) using their original equipment. It is easy to say
that the Tombstone Jack system has been part of leveling over 1.5 Million monuments since we started
in 2011.
 

## Meet Mr. Tombstone Jack

Inspired by real craftsmen in the field, Mr. Tombstone Jack teaches the skills, care, and attention
required to restore monuments the right way. No swinging loads, no scratched stones, and no risky
lifts — just clean, precise restoration using tools designed specifically for cemeteries. With the
Tombstone Jack™ system, he shows how to lift with control, fit into tight spaces, and protect
historic stones while honoring the craft and the communities we serve. Give us a call to discuss
your cemetery needs! [660-605-0259][14]

[Screenshot 2025-12-02 at 7.54.42 AM.png]

## Training & Support

The system is easy to use, and we provide full training to ensure confidence from day one.
Sixty-five% of our customers are volunteers who continue to train and support new team members year
after year.

 

Would you like to see our demonstration videos? We would love to help make your monument maintenance
safer and more efficient. Contact us at [660-605-0259][15] or [michael@tombstonejack.com][16] and we
will provide any additional training or support you need. 


Benjamin Franklin famously observed: “Show me your cemetery, and I will tell you the character of
your community.” Cemeteries are a reflection of a community’s values, showcasing its respect for
history, culture, and those who came before. A community’s character is not just in its people—rich
or poor, young or old—but in the collective effort to preserve shared spaces and maintain its
heritage. The Tombstone Jack™ is a purpose-built solution that empowers communities to restore and
maintain cemetery monuments safely

and effectively.


Thank you for your time reading this important message. Tombstone Jack is here to support those
working to preserve cemeteries by  ~one precious grave at a time.


Best regards,


Michael Andersen 
Founder & President, Tombstone Jack Inc.

-Impressive Capacity: Lifts up to 3,000 pounds with clamps alone, and up to 12,000 pounds with the

-Safety First: Four precision-engineered clamps generate 10,000 pounds of clamping force, ensuring a
secure hold without the risks of pry bars or unstable lifting.
-Built to Last: Made in the USA. Requires minimal maintenance; just grease the screws after every
100 lifts for generations of reliability.

Introducing the Tombstone Jack™, the most advanced monument and gravestone tool available. You can

"As the manager of cemetery operations in Cleveland, I oversee nine active cemeteries and personally
participate in a wide range of monument work—including leveling aging headstones and installing new
monuments. A few years ago, I purchased my first Tombstone Jack system, and after seeing how
effective and reliable it was, I added a second unit to meet the increasing demands across our
cemeteries. Simply put, I couldn’t do this work without Tombstone Jack. While I do use a mini
excavator for transport and some of the heavier lifting, it can’t access many of the tight, delicate
areas where precision and care are critical. The Tombstone Jack system is compact, powerful, and
uniquely suited for this kind of work. The Tombstone Jack is great for small tombstones and tablets
even up to very large 12,000 lb. monuments. Every cemetery presents different challenges, and this
equipment gives me the confidence to address each one with safety, efficiency, and craftsmanship.
Thanks to Tombstone Jack, I’m able to complete more projects each day without compromising the
respect and attention each monument deserves. I can set up, level, and move on quickly—something
that simply wasn’t possible before. The design, quality, and integrity behind this product is 
exceptional, and my experience with Tombstone Jack’s management has been equally
impressive—responsive, professional, and committed to excellence. I look forward to the innovations
yet to come and continuing our relationship with Tombstone Jack Inc."

Brett C.

[Tombstone Arizona]

### **Experience the Old West in the “Town Too Tough to Die” – Tombstone, Arizona!**

Step back in time and immerse yourself in the rugged charm of Tombstone, where history comes alive
on every corner. Stroll the same streets once walked by Wyatt Earp, Doc Holliday, and a host of
legendary figures from the Wild West. Explore historic buildings where weary miners once gambled
over games of Faro and Poker, or venture underground to the very mines where fortunes were made.

Stand in the places where iconic stories unfolded, and let the authentic spirit of the Old West
transport you to another era.

### **Your Wild West Adventure Starts Here!**

From fascinating museums and history tours by foot, stagecoach, or trolley to thrilling underground
mine adventures and ghostly paranormal encounters, Tombstone offers a rich tapestry of experiences
for every visitor. Indulge in unique shopping, savor delicious dining, and witness electrifying
gunfight reenactments that bring the Wild West to life.

Whether you're planning a day trip or an unforgettable overnight stay, Tombstone has something for
everyone. Let **TombstoneWeb**, the town’s most trusted travel guide, help you explore all that
Tombstone, Arizona, has to offer!

### What is a Headstone

A **headstone**, **tombstone**, or **gravestone** is a stele or marker, usually stone, that is
placed over a grave. They are traditional for burials in the Christian, Jewish and Muslim religions,
among others. In most cases they have the deceased’s name, date of birth, and date of death
inscribed on them, along with a personal message, or prayer, but they may contain pieces of funerary
art, especially details in stone relief. In many parts of Europe insetting a photograph of the
deceased in a frame is very common

### Headstone Use

The stele (plural stelae), as it is called in an archaeological context, is one of the oldest forms
of funerary art. Originally, a tombstone was the stone lid of a stone coffin, or the coffin itself,
and a gravestone was the stone slab that was laid over a grave. Now all three terms are also used

### What is a Headstone

A **headstone**, **tombstone**, or **gravestone** is a stele or marker, usually stone, that is
placed over a grave. They are traditional for burials in the Christian, Jewish and Muslim religions,
among others. In most cases they have the deceased’s name, date of birth, and date of death
inscribed on them, along with a personal message, or prayer, but they may contain pieces of funerary
art, especially details in stone relief. In many parts of Europe insetting a photograph of the
deceased in a frame is very common

### Headstone Use

The stele (plural stelae), as it is called in an archaeological context, is one of the oldest forms
of funerary art. Originally, a tombstone was the stone lid of a stone coffin, or the coffin itself,
and a gravestone was the stone slab that was laid over a grave. Now all three terms are also used
for markers placed at the head of the grave. Some graves in the 18th century also contained
footstones to demarcate the foot end of the grave. This sometimes developed into full kerb sets that
marked the whole perimeter of the grave. Footstones were rarely annotated with more than the
deceased’s initials and year of death, and sometimes a memorial mason and plot reference number.
Many cemeteries and churchyards have removed those extra stones to ease grass cutting by machine
mower. Note that in some UK cemeteries the principal, and indeed only, marker is placed at the foot
of the grave.

Owing to soil movement and Downhill creep on gentle slopes, older headstones and footstones can
often be found tilted at an angle. Over time, this movement can result in the stones being sited
several metres away from their original location.

Graves, and any related memorials are a focus for mourning and remembrance. The names of relatives
are often added to a gravestone over the years, so that one marker may chronicle the passing of an
entire family spread over decades. Since gravestones and a plot in a cemetery or churchyard cost
money, they are also a symbol of wealth or prominence in a community. Some gravestones were even
commissioned and erected to their own memory by people who were still living, as a testament to
their wealth and status. In a Christian context, the very wealthy often erected elaborate memorials
within churches rather than having simply external gravestones. Crematoria frequently offer similar
alternatives to families who do not have a grave to mark, but who want a focus for their mourning
and for remembrance. Carved or cast commemorative plaques inside the crematorium for example may
serve this purpose.

### Headstone Material

A cemetery may follow national codes of practice or independently prescribe the size and use of
certain materials, especially in a conservation area. Some may limit the placing of a wooden
memorial to six months after burial, after which a more permanent memorial must be placed. Others
may require stones of a certain shape or position to facilitate grass-cutting. Headstones of
granite, marble and other kinds of stoneare usually created, installed, and repaired by monumental
masons. Cemeteries require regular inspection and maintenance, as stones may settle, topple and, on
rare occasions, fall and injure people or graves may simply become overgrown and their markers lost
or vandalised.

Restoration is a specialized job for a monumental mason. Even overgrowth removal requires care to
avoid damaging the carving. For example, ivy should only be cut at the base roots and left to
naturally die off, never pulled off forcefully. Many materials have been used as markers.

**Fieldstones. **The earliest markers for graves were natural fieldstone, some unmarked and others
decorated or incised using a metal awl. Typical motifs for the carving included a symbol and the
deceased’s name and age.
**Granite.** Granite is a hard stone and requires skill to carve by hand. Modern methods of carving
include using computer-controlled rotary bits and sandblasting over a rubber stencil. Leaving the
letters, numbers and emblems exposed on the stone, the blaster can create virtually any kind of
artwork or epitaph.
**Marble and limestone.** Both limestone and marble take carving well. Marble is a recrystallised
form of limestone. The mild acid in rainwater can slowly dissolve marble and limestone over time,
which can make inscriptions unreadable. Portland stone was a type of limestone commonly used in
England—after weathering, fossiliferous deposits tend to appear on the surface. Marble became
popular from the early 19th century, though its extra cost limited its appeal.
**Sandstone. **Sandstone is durable, yet soft enough to carve easily. Some sandstone markers are so
well preserved that individual chisel marks are discernible, while others have delaminated and
crumbled to dust. Delamination occurs when moisture gets between the layers of the sandstone. As it
freezes and expands the layers flake off. In the 17th century, sandstone replaced field stones in
Colonial America. Yorkstone was a common sandstone material used in England.
**Slate.** Slate can have a pleasing texture but is slightly porous and prone to delamination. It
takes lettering well, often highlighted with white paint or gilding.

### headstone Inscriptions

Markers sometimes bear inscriptions. The information on the headstone generally includes the name of
the deceased and their date of birth and death. Such information can be useful to genealogists and
local historians. Larger cemeteries may require a discreet reference code as well to help accurately
fix the location for maintenance. The cemetery owner, church, or, as in the UK, national guidelines
might encourage the use of ‘tasteful’ and accurate wording in inscriptions. The placement of
inscriptions is traditionally placed on the forward-facing side of the memorial but can also be seen
in some cases on the reverse and around the edges of the stone itself. Some families request that an
inscription be made on the portion of the memorial that will be underground.
